courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 首爾清溪川復育
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: Emschergenossenschaft介紹埃姆舍流域以污水幹管、處理廠及河川重整共同完成轉型，強調流域尺度工程的相互依賴。
courses.summaryEn: Emschergenossenschaft describes basin transformation through sewers, treatment plants and river restructuring, emphasizing interdependent infrastructure.

history.title: 德國埃姆舍河整治
history.text: Emschergenossenschaft介紹埃姆舍流域以污水幹管、處理廠及河川重整共同完成轉型，強調流域尺度工程的相互依賴。
history.textEn: Emschergenossenschaft describes basin transformation through sewers, treatment plants and river restructuring, emphasizing interdependent infrastructure.

courses.connection: 埃姆舍轉型先把污水從河道移入管網與處理系統，再改善河岸與棲地。學徒需檢查污水未分離時，單做景觀能否持續維持水質。
courses.connectionEn: The Emscher transformation moves sewage from the river into sewers and treatment before restoring banks and habitat. Learners assess whether landscaping alone can sustain water quality without sewage separation.
